## Problem

What recurring problem would this solve, and for whom?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest reusable behavior that would solve it.

## Evidence

Link to a reproducible project, workflow, or repeated request when available. Do not include private project data.

## Scope check

- [ ] This applies to more than one project or workflow.
- [ ] This does not add portal credentials or automatic submission.
- [ ] This does not promise approval, revenue, or retention.
